top_signals.title: Trump offers UFC chief Dana White press secretary job
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump offered the job of press secretary to UFC president and CEO Dana White on Saturday.

top_signals.title: 31-year-old dumpster diver brought in $140,000 in 12 months: I 'did much more than I thought was possible'
top_signals.summary: Carter Stevens started reselling discarded items from dumpsters around Nashville, Tennessee, in March 2024. Months earlier, he'd been living in his car.
